programs.title: WWE Rivals
programs.desc: After dominating most of the WWE roster in the mid 90s, Undertaker needed an opponent who could push him both physically and mentally; Mankind, aka Mick Foley, became that perfect adversary for The Deadman.

programs.title: WWE LFG
programs.desc: After receiving deflating feedback last match, Chris Island puts in extra effort and looks to turn his fortunes around when he faces off against the newest member of LFG, the sensation from Madrid, Jaime Garcia; Kevin Owens helps Nathan Cranton and Mike Derudder on their character development; in the main event, Zena Sterling looks to Booker T to help add an edge as she takes on Nikkita Lyons.

programs.title: WWE's Greatest Moments
programs.desc: We celebrate the top moments from SmackDown's second decade; features the Steel Cage clash between Jeff Hardy and CM Punk, Edge's shocking cash-in on The Undertaker, AJ Styles capturing the WWE Championship in Britain, The Rock making his return to the house he built and more.

programs.title: WWE's Greatest Moments
programs.desc: Sometimes in the unpredictable world of WWE, rivalries become too personal to be settled inside the ring and superstars sometimes find the backstage area more suitable to settle their differences; witness some of the most tumultuous backstage assaults in WWE history with moments featuring The Rock, Hollywood Hogan, The Undertaker, "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes and so much more!
